revision.meaning: Reconstructs one historical GEL tutorial as an editable draft. Submission would create a new GEL tutorial; the source identity remains provenance only.

new.meaning: Represents a new tutorial draft. A prepopulation source, if present, is provenance and is never the identity of the future created tutorial.
new.prepopulation_source_rule: When a prior tutorial exists it must be the latest tutorial; for a first-ever tutorial the source is absent.
new.teacher_authority: opaque ValidatedNewFormTeacher derived only from the validated N2b hidden tid source control
new.identity_resolution_rule: Never predict tutorial_id/tutorial_ts; a future successful create resolves identity only by fresh GEL readback.

provenance_only.overall_level_source_raw: Retain the literal GEL select value for diagnostics; never use it as POST fallback.
provenance_only.aims_source_html: Retain historical #tcinput inner HTML for fidelity; never use it as the editable Aims value or POST fallback.
provenance_only.edit_form_absent: Retain the historical edit checkbox value and discrepancy marker; never override summary/archive absent on revision construction.

failure_semantics: Revision construction requires historical state authority permitted by the reconciliation_authority contract.
Revision origin source student_uid and tutorial_type must match the semantic draft.
A New draft prepopulation source, when present, must belong to the same student and is provenance only; it is not the future tutorial identity.
Type-inapplicable semantic values fail validation rather than being silently omitted.
New submission containing datetime is a contract violation; blank/zero/source timestamps are not substitutes for omission.
Revision submission missing datetime or using a timestamp different from its source identity is a contract violation.
New teacher must equal the immutable validated New-form teacher authority; Revision teacher must equal the immutable historical teacher authority.
No Writer/public API may mutate teacher attribution during N2.
No authoritative GEL identity may be fabricated for New before fresh server readback.
No semantic field provenance may be inferred from equality with an unrelated field.
Network write authority is granted exclusively through live_submission_transport under Phase W2.
UI1c typed edits to read-only, hidden-preserved or inapplicable fields fail with structured FIELD_NOT_APPLICABLE and do not mutate the draft.
New UI1c CEFR edits lower than a populated same-role latest-source baseline fail with structured LEVEL_REGRESSION; Revision has no later-tutorial regression comparison.

revision_state_authority.rule: Revision construction must fail closed before semantic state creation when the historical state authority does not permit revision-by-ID.

teacher_authority.new: Teacher ID is immutable submission authority derived from the validated fetched New form; Writer/UI must not expose reassignment.
teacher_authority.revision: Teacher ID is immutable submission authority from the historical Revision form/tutorial; ordinary revision must preserve it.
teacher_authority.gel_source_capability: Existing GEL Revision forms may expose an editable teacher selector, but this does not grant Writer mutation authority.

new: ValidatedNewTutorialForm fetched and validated under current authenticated session
opaque ValidatedNewFormTeacher derived from hidden tid

editable_derived_state: semantic level/assessment/text fields permitted by tutorial type
state_authority.derived_submission_state: GEL successful-control payload produced only by rust_post_mapper

permitted_writers.editable_semantic_fields: rust_semantic_form for initial construction; future Writer draft editor/UI for subsequent user edits

invalidation.new_prepopulation_source_changed: If a fresh read shows a different latest tutorial than the source snapshot, mark the New draft stale; never silently reinterpret it against the newer source.
invalidation.authentication_lost: A fetched New-form teacher authority is invalid after session loss; refetch/revalidate the New form before any future create.
invalidation.revision_source_changed: Revision conflict/staleness handling must not silently alter source identity or historical teacher.

canonical_level_field_identity.rule: Field identity/semantic role is authoritative. Equal CEFR values in unrelated fields never establish cross-field provenance.

new_prepopulation.source: latest tutorial when present; first-ever has no source
new_prepopulation.date_rule: validated New-form default, never historical date
new_prepopulation.skill_rule: same canonical semantic role only; Initial-role fields copy only from Initial/Final sources, current-role fields copy only from Standard/Final sources, otherwise validated New-form defaults
new_prepopulation.reading_rule: copy source Reading when present, else validated New-form default

type_specific.initial: copy exam only from Initial source, else New-form defaults
type_specific.standard: copy self-assessment and Aims only from Standard source, else New-form defaults
type_specific.final: copy additional comments only from Final source, else New-form default

ui1c0_semantic_editor.initial_course_type: Rust InitialCourseType adapter over Initial teacher_comments storage; unknown nonblank text preserved until explicit SetInitialCourseType replacement
ui1c0_semantic_editor.hidden_initial_exam_policy: preserved unchanged; no UI1c typed edit variant
ui1c0_semantic_editor.new_level_regression: same canonical field-role only using the N2c latest-source snapshot baseline stored on DraftOrigin::New
